gwt.given: a command's source DbParameterCollection contains two NpgsqlParameters in order — "@id" with Value 7, then "@code" with Value "A1" — and SetParameters is called with queryParameterNames null and parameterValues null
gwt.then: the command ends up with exactly two independent parameter copies in that same source order — "@id" with Value 7, then "@code" with Value "A1" — because a null/empty queryParameterNames selects every source parameter in source order and there is no parameterValues dictionary to consult
